title: Notes App — Dogfood
intro:
Local app: http://localhost:5173. API: http://localhost:3001.
Agent progress: dogfood mark writes this run file — do not tick this HTML in Chrome.

cases.title: Create a note
cases.try: Open app → click "New note" → type title Alpha and body hello → Save.
cases.expect: Note "Alpha" appears in the list with body preview "hello".

cases.title: Note survives reload
cases.setup: note Alpha exists from CASE-1 or seed
cases.expect: "Alpha" is still in the list (not only client memory).
cases.backend: GET /api/notes still includes Alpha after reload

cases.title: Empty title rejected
cases.try: New note → leave title empty → Save.
cases.expect: Inline error "Title is required"; no new list row.
cases.backend: POST /api/notes returns 4xx; no new note id

cases.title: Rename note
cases.try: Open "Alpha" → change title to Beta → Save.
cases.backend: GET /api/notes includes Beta and not Alpha as that id's title

cases.title: Delete note
cases.try: Open "Beta" → Delete → confirm in the app dialog (in-app, not window.confirm).
cases.backend: DELETE returns 2xx; GET /api/notes has no Beta

cases.title: Empty state copy
cases.try: With no notes, open the list view.
cases.expect: Centered copy: "No notes yet — create your first."
